import json, os, time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = "/app/output"
RUNS = "/app/runs"
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(RUNS, exist_ok=True)
r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
print(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
obs = r.get_obs()
print("OBS META", json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
for cam, img in obs.last.items():
    name = cam.replace(":", "_")
    Image.fromarray(img).save(os.path.join(OUT, f"initial_{name}.jpg"))

def observe(seconds=0, video="frames"):
    global obs
    obs = r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, video=video)
    for cam, img in obs.last.items():
        name = cam.replace(":", "_")
        Image.fromarray(img).save(os.path.join(OUT, f"latest_{name}.jpg"))
    print("META", json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
    return obs

def submit_joint(actions, dt=1/30, interpolate="linear", note=""):
    global res
    res = r.submit("joint_position", np.asarray(actions, dtype=np.float32), dt=dt, interpolate=interpolate, note=note)
    print("RESULT", json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
    for cam, img in res.last.items():
        name = cam.replace(":", "_")
        Image.fromarray(img).save(os.path.join(OUT, f"latest_{name}.jpg"))
    return res

def submit_ee(actions, note=""):
    global res
    res = r.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(actions, dtype=np.float32), note=note)
    print("RESULT", json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
    for cam, img in res.last.items():
        name = cam.replace(":", "_")
        Image.fromarray(img).save(os.path.join(OUT, f"latest_{name}.jpg"))
    return res

def save_result(result, name):
    path = os.path.join(RUNS, name)
    result.save(path)
    print("SAVED", path)

print("Driver ready. Helpers: observe(), submit_joint(), submit_ee(), save_result().")

"""BEHAVIOR-1K limited-mode gift bag episode driver.
Run with: python -i /app/output/gen.py
"""
import json, os, time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = "/app/output"
RUNS = "/app/runs"
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(RUNS, exist_ok=True)
r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
print(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
obs = r.get_obs()
print("OBS META", json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
for cam, img in obs.last.items():
    name = cam.replace(":", "_")
    Image.fromarray(img).save(os.path.join(OUT, f"initial_{name}.jpg"))

def observe(seconds=0, video="frames"):
    global obs
    obs = r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, video=video)
    for cam, img in obs.last.items():
        name = cam.replace(":", "_")
        Image.fromarray(img).save(os.path.join(OUT, f"latest_{name}.jpg"))
    print("META", json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
    return obs

def submit_joint(actions, dt=1/30, interpolate="linear", note=""):
    global res
    res = r.submit("joint_position", np.asarray(actions, dtype=np.float32), dt=dt, interpolate=interpolate, note=note)
    print("RESULT", json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
    for cam, img in res.last.items():
        name = cam.replace(":", "_")
        Image.fromarray(img).save(os.path.join(OUT, f"latest_{name}.jpg"))
    return res

def submit_ee(actions, note=""):
    global res
    res = r.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(actions, dtype=np.float32), note=note)
    print("RESULT", json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
    for cam, img in res.last.items():
        name = cam.replace(":", "_")
        Image.fromarray(img).save(os.path.join(OUT, f"latest_{name}.jpg"))
    return res

def save_result(result, name):
    path = os.path.join(RUNS, name)
    result.save(path)
    print("SAVED", path)

print("Driver ready. Helpers: observe(), submit_joint(), submit_ee(), save_result().")
